rules.sentence: For example, starting an intrathecal ASO treatment in a patient with AT and a manifest hematological malignancy poorly responding to treatment and severely limiting the life expectancy is likely futile (i.e., extra-CNS disease manifestation as an exclusion criterion).

Yet another patient with AT, although still at heightened risk for developing a malignancy, might qualify for an ASO treatment if quality of life is mainly determined by the neurological disease burden which might be prevented by an ASO therapy (i.e., extra-CNS disease manifestation as a weighting criterion).
